_comment: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regional control-mapping profile. Governed primarily by MAS FEAT Principles (Fairness, Ethics, Accountability, Transparency) and MAS Notice 655 / TRM Guidelines. To activate: set CAGE_DEPLOYMENT_REGION=APAC_MAS
_references: MAS FEAT Principles (Fairness, Ethics, Accountability, Transparency) — November 2019
MAS TRM Guidelines – Technology Risk Management Guidelines (January 2021)
MAS Guidelines on Environmental Risk Management (ENRM) for Banks — December 2020
NIST AI RMF 1.0 (adopted as supplementary reference)

CTRL_AGT_001.primary_framework: MAS FEAT – Fairness Principle F1: Bias Impact Assessment
co_frameworks: MAS FEAT – Ethics Principle E2: Well-reasoned AI Decisions
MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3 – AI and Machine Learning Controls
CTRL_AGT_001.description: Minimum agentic model confidence required to execute a decision. Under MAS FEAT Principle F1, AI decisions affecting customers must be regularly tested for bias. The confidence threshold is a necessary but not sufficient control: MAS expects ongoing Fairness Impact Assessments (FIA) with quantitative bias metrics across demographic groups. MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3 require documented model risk management for AI/ML systems, including drift detection and performance monitoring, which the DoWhy causal gatekeeper directly satisfies.

CTRL_WAL_002.primary_framework: MAS TRM Guidelines §9.1 – Business Continuity Management
co_frameworks: MAS FEAT – Accountability Principle A3: Explainable AI Decisions
CTRL_WAL_002.description: Atomic transaction guarantee via Write-Ahead Log and LIFO rollback. MAS TRM Guidelines §9.1 require financial institutions to maintain business continuity for critical systems with documented recovery procedures. MAS Notice 655 §12 specifies Recovery Time Objectives that the WAL LIFO rollback mechanism directly satisfies by ensuring no partial transaction state persists. MAS FEAT Accountability Principle A3 requires that AI decisions be explainable; WAL audit trails provide the decision provenance required for this.

CTRL_TEL_003.primary_framework: MAS TRM Guidelines §6.4 – Model Risk Management and Monitoring
co_frameworks: MAS FEAT – Transparency Principle T1: Decision Explainability
MAS FEAT – Accountability Principle A2: Audit Trail Requirements
CTRL_TEL_003.description: World-model validation must reflect live runtime telemetry. MAS TRM Guidelines §6.4 mandate continuous monitoring of AI model performance in production, including drift detection. MAS FEAT Transparency Principle T1 requires that AI systems be able to explain their decisions to affected customers and regulators. MAS Notice 655 §10 requires audit logs that enable reconstruction of all system decisions. The live Langfuse governance spans directly satisfy all three requirements.

CTRL_OPA_005.primary_framework: MAS FEAT – Accountability Principle A1: Defined Human Oversight
co_frameworks: MAS FEAT – Ethics Principle E3: AI System Boundaries
CTRL_OPA_005.description: OPA policy evaluation must ALLOW before any agentic action is executed. MAS FEAT Accountability Principle A1 requires that financial institutions define clear human oversight responsibilities for AI systems. The OPA MANUAL_REVIEW outcome is the technical implementation of this human oversight requirement. MAS FEAT Ethics Principle E3 requires that AI systems operate within defined boundaries; OPA DENY outcomes enforce these boundaries. MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3.2 explicitly requires human-in-the-loop controls for high-impact AI decisions, directly mapping to the MANUAL_REVIEW escalation path.

co_frameworks: MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3 – Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
MAS TRM Guidelines §4.2 – Data Residency and Sovereignty
MAS FEAT – Accountability Principle A2: Audit Trail Requirements
CTRL_TQP_007.description: Per-session token and step-count quota enforcement via Redis atomic Lua counters. Blocks execution when sequence_step_count > 12 OR accumulated_tokens > 100,000. Fail-CLOSED: Redis unavailable blocks the request. Every blocked execution produces a KMS-signed UCA record persisted to the WORM ledger within asia-southeast1 only (MAS TRM Guidelines §4.2 data residency). Pre-ledger PII sanitization applied per ISO 42001 Annex A.6. MAS Notice 655 §10 audit logging satisfied by WORM-persisted UCA records. MAS FEAT Accountability Principle A2 audit trail requirement satisfied by KMS-signed, immutable UCA records. WORM bucket routed via OSCAL_S3_BUCKET_APAC_MAS environment variable. Primary enforcer: TokenQuotaProxy (Python, Redis Lua). Secondary declarative evidence: OPA quota_within_limits rule.
